## Is this a CLI feature or configuration?

<!--
Before submitting, please check if your request is:
- 🛠️ CLI Feature: New commands, prompt improvements, output formatting, workflow changes
- ⚙️ Configuration: Custom commit types, messages, or settings (check ~/.merlinrc.json docs)

If this is just about customizing existing behavior, you may be able to solve it with configuration!
Check the configuration options in the README or docs.
-->

- [ ] This is a CLI feature request (not just configuration)
